candidates.story: ZGCM-1 open model and training release
candidates.reason: Today’s exact RSS announcement, public MIT-labelled model/code and a gated multi-license data collection create a concrete research and deployment decision.

Still within 48 hours by the prior retained RSS ledger, but its paper was submitted 4 September and HF repository created in August; ZGCM is newer and offers a clearer release/access question. Occamy remains unpublished after a prior hold.
Published in run 20260914T080209Z; ZGCM concerns a distinct model/training release.
Developer-created benchmark limits immediate external validation; less testable release detail than ZGCM.

decision.reason: Select the today-announced ZGCM-1 release for bounded analysis of what its public weights, code and conditional data access allow. Developer benchmark and efficiency claims remain attributed and unreplicated.

claims.text: arXiv cs.AI announced 2609.13356v1 as new at 15 September 2026 04:00 UTC; manuscript v1 was submitted 11 September 17:18:04 UTC.
claims.sourceLocator: s1 item pubDate and Announce Type; s2 submission history.

claims.text: ZGCM team releases a 7.39B dense model trained from scratch with 32 layers, 27 gated SWA layers, five global layers and 262,144-token maximum context.
HF model is public ungated, MIT-labelled and contains four weight shards plus custom modelling code, with 16.52 GB of stored material.
claims.sourceLocator: s3 public file list and live API metadata.

claims.text: The GitHub repository contains data-process, pretrain, midtrain, SFT and RL directories and stage documentation; repo push was 15 September 07:26:16 UTC.
claims.sourceLocator: s5 tree and GitHub API pushed_at.

claims.text: The dataset has six Parquet configurations, about 5.74 TB in repository metadata, a manual access gate and top-level licence other.
claims.sourceLocator: s4 API metadata, card and access banner; s6 meaning of gated manual.

claims.text: Dataset records can carry per-item upstream licences; some index_only records provide locators without training text and upstream sources require separate terms or approval.
claims.sourceLocator: s4 Dataset Structure, Index-only Records, Sources Requiring Separate Upstream Access.

claims.text: A manual gated dataset asks users to share contact information and leaves access request approval under author control.
claims.sourceLocator: s4 access banner/API; s6 Access gated datasets and Manage sections.

claims.text: OSI AI definition distinguishes parameters, code and detailed data information and does not require redistribution of every raw item; this article does not make a ZGCM compliance finding.
claims.sourceLocator: s7 version 1.0; limited to contextual standard.

claims.text: Ai2 Olmo 3 shows another independent weights/code/data release design, not ZGCM validation.
claims.sourceLocator: s8 release description; comparison restricted to release choices.

claims.text: Team reports 3.94-times throughput and 6.4-times KV-cache reduction at 256K in its architecture experiments.
claims.sourceLocator: s2 sections 2.2-2.3 and Figure 4; conditions of experiment preserved.

claims.text: Team estimates 4.2-times 16K pretraining time-to-loss against BF16/AdamW baseline by multiplying 1.4, 1.5, 1.8 and estimated 1.1 factors.
claims.sourceLocator: s2 section 3.1.3; this is a combined estimate, not a measured full-cycle cost.

claims.text: Team reports 75.00% AIME 2026, 97.13% MATH-500, 70.42% HMMT 2025 and weaker knowledge/instruction rows in its 256K SFT think-mode evaluation.
claims.sourceLocator: s2 Table 2 and section 5.1; s3 selected benchmark table.

claims.text: Team reports 63.09% WebWalkerQA, 19.43% BrowseComp and 42.52% text-only GAIA with up to 64 search/read steps; many cross-model web baselines come from other reports.
claims.sourceLocator: s2 Table 3 and sections 5.1-5.3; mixed protocol explicitly qualified.

claims.text: Team reports 31/50 Binary Function Search exact matches on a ten-project held-out subset under Ghidra protocol and says public benchmark release is planned.
claims.sourceLocator: s2 section 5.3 and Table 4; s3 agentic search results.

claims.text: Team acknowledges difficult repository/terminal tasks and tool-format or observation brittleness.
Use-case evaluation and training reproduction require different verification plans; paper scores cannot forecast local accepted outcomes or complete cost.
claims.sourceLocator: Premises: s2 mixed protocols and developer-produced measures; s4 access/rights; s5 code/stages; s6 gate meaning. Boundary: recommendation, no test performed.

s2.note: Only the two-word phrase fully open is quoted; numerical and method facts are paraphrased with local citations.

notes: Led with the actual release and conditional data access, then removed repeated thesis statements and duplicate closing qualifications while retaining the explicit documentation-only limit.
Changed uniform section labels and source-by-source transitions into a clearer sequence: inspect the release, read each efficiency measure, interpret the test setup, then plan a bounded trial.

Preserved the exact event and submission timestamps, reported figures, local source links, mixed-protocol and licence caveats, Index Us Editorial byline, and required automation disclosure. Recalculated readingMinutes to 9 from 1,730 validator-counted words.

Inspected the final SVG against ArticleArtwork.astro and the Terms.txt and Salesforce inline examples: its offset weights/code/data plates and request marker are distinct, use the established grid, registration marks and palette, and imply no benchmark measurement or training proportions. Accessible title/description and visible original-illustration caption remain exact. Mobile and desktop rendering are still pending.

Independently reopened all eight public source locations, exact arXiv RSS timing, arXiv v1 methods and claims, live Hugging Face model/dataset APIs, GitHub API, Hugging Face gate rules, OSI and Ai2 context.

Checked every final material claim, all reported metrics and protocol caveats, headline, description, takeaways, nearby citations, byline, disclosure and actual testing limits; no unsupported material claim remains.

Verified that the two-word fully open quote is precisely attributed, developer sources share one evidence family, independent context does not validate ZGCM performance, and no W&B log, model, Parquet, benchmark task set or source-level licence was accessed.
Passed final inline SVG source inspection for style, distinct composition, accessibility and non-evidentiary interpretation; mobile and desktop rendered geometry remains a separate gate.
